name: ENGR 5520
title: Technology Innovation and Entrepreneurship II
description: (Also offered as MENT 5520.) Focuses on entrepreneurship concepts and approaches such as user-centric technology startup development, customer discovery, user experience and design, and financial analysis. The course is taught through an experiential project-based and authentic learning approach using both lectures and student participation and presentations.
requirement_description: ENGR 3500 or MENT 3500 or ENGR 5510. Instructor consent required.
